messages:
Maya (Design): uploaded an updated autoscale panel mock (min/max, SLO slider, GPU pool selector, burst toggle). quick feedback request: figma: https://figma.com/file/preview123
Alex (Product): great. primary ask: make the SLO slider feel friendly. add presets (Fast 50 ms / Balanced 100 ms / Cost 200 ms) with tiny helper copy explaining tradeoffs.
Samir (Eng): backend notes: pool types are g4, l4, a100. pools API can return estimate qps and $/hr. dropdown should support typeahead.
Leah (Accessibility): a11y pass: 1) slider keyboard: arrows = 1% step, PgUp/PgDn = 10%. 2) ensure secondary copy contrast >= 4.5:1. 3) mark guardrail messages with role="status" for SR announcement.
Jon (SRE): burst needs a tooltip: "Burst uses spare GPU capacity for short spikes; billed while active. Default cap = 2x reserved." also require telemetry: capacity.burst.triggered {team_id, pool, duration_s}.
Maya (Design): draft guardrail copy: "Note: estimated p95 with selected pool is ~120 ms. Consider a higher-performance pool or enabling burst." Leah prefer tone?
Leah (Accessibility): neutral is good. add role=status and ensure it's reachable by keyboard focus.
Alex (Product): recommend showing a suggested min/max band from org history with a one-click 'Apply recommended' button. reduces friction.
Samir (Eng): we can expose /orgs/{id}/autoscale/suggest returning recommended_min, recommended_max, and rationale. also confirm: if new min > current instances UI must require confirmation and explain migration.
Maya (Design): noted. I'll add a confirmation modal: "Apply and migrate (may restart)" vs "Apply without migration". modal will trap focus.
Leah (Accessibility): modal needs descriptive aria-label and visible close. ensure labels are programmatic (aria-labelledby).
ops-bot: uploaded new figma: https://figma.com/file/preview123?node-id=7 :thumbsup:
Alex (Product): acceptance criteria draft: 1) keyboard-accessible SLO slider + presets; 2) GPU pool dropdown shows qps & $/hr and supports typeahead; 3) burst toggle w/ tooltip & billing note; 4) guardrail appears with role=status; 5) recommended min/max shown with one-click apply and confirmed migration flow.
Maya (Design): thanks! will update mocks and add ARIA notes in the spec. will post again tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
